seoTitle: URL List Sorter and Folder Counter by Path Depth
metaDescription: Sort a URL list by folder and see how many URLs sit in each folder and at each depth. Handy for sitemap, crawl and log exports.
intro: Groups URLs under their folders at the level you choose, counts them, shows the depth distribution and lists the URLs sorted by path.
why:
A flat list of thousands of URLs hides the structure of a site. Counting by folder shows where the pages are, which sections are large and how deep the site goes.

Pick the folder level (1 = first folder, 2 = first two folders). A URL that is a file or page directly in a folder counts toward that folder; the last path segment is never treated as a folder. Nothing is requested: it only reads the list.
howTo: Choose the folder level and order.
Read the folder table and depth table.
Switch off the URL list if you only need the counts.

faq.a: The number of path segments. The home page is 0, /blog/post is 2.

faq.q: Is the last segment a folder?
faq.a: No. /shop/widgets groups under /shop/ with widgets as the page.
Only the path is used for grouping, so different hosts with the same path end up together.

faq.q: How big a list can it take?
faq.a: Tens of thousands of lines are fine in a modern browser.
